phase: Phase 2 - authenticated student profile and curriculum catalogue (pre-pilot)
notes: Supabase project learning-radar is active in Tokyo (ap-northeast-1).
Seven database migrations have been applied to the remote project and are recorded in its migration history.
115 academic-year Ministry of Education school directory imported: 2,609 elementary and 740 junior-high schools.
238 active 115 academic-year NAER-approved textbook publisher/grade/subject/volume options seeded; Grade 9 Social Studies publisher options corrected against the official directory.
All 13 public tables have RLS enabled. Anonymous role has no public table or sequence grants; authenticated role has minimum application grants, with RLS enforcing row ownership.
Default privileges for future public tables, sequences and functions created by postgres have been tightened.
GitHub Actions passed npm ci, TypeScript typecheck and Next.js production build on Node.js 26.
Vercel Production deployment is READY at https://learning-radar-wheat.vercel.app; Preview deployments remain SSO protected while Production is publicly accessible.
Signup email confirmation callback, differentiated login errors and resend-confirmation action are implemented. Real mailbox end-to-end verification remains untested.

supabase/config.toml contains production Site URL and redirect patterns. The hosted Supabase Dashboard Authentication URL Configuration must still be checked/set manually; changing config.toml does not update hosted Auth settings.
Supabase Security Advisor currently reports leaked-password protection disabled; this feature requires Pro or above.
Publisher textbook contents, unit lists and knowledge-point details still require verified/licensed source data; AI question generation and assessment analysis are not yet implemented.
Minors' privacy notice and guardian consent workflow must be completed before public launch.
